- Sort the images by creation date
- Populate `RepoTags` with all the tags pointing to an image instead of having multiple objects of the same image in the array.

Fixes #43848

issue_context.title: containerd integration: make sure images are sorted, and optimize before/since filters
issue_context.body:
### Description

- relates to https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/43816

The previous implementation sorted the results by "created" (descending order); https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/7624f8aeb1836cd75a0912d9614930e8a59eaf4e/daemon/images/image_list.go#L241

We can either sort locally, or possibly optimize and have containerd return the result in sorted order.

When sorting the results, we can also optimize the `before` and `since` filters to break the loop if we're reaching a certain "created" date.
comments: As far as things containerd supports here, it _does_ support some amount of string-based filtering (`name=="foo"`) that we might be able to use to optimize some limited set of our filters, but doesn't appear to natively support any sorting or ordering today.

review_comments:
This looked scary at first; was wondering if it would be sorting _twice_ to reverse it, but looks like `sort.Reverse` just overrides the underlying `sort.Interface` and flips the values.

Slightly wondering though if we always sort `byCreated` in reverse order, or we should update the order there.
Comes from https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/master/daemon/images/image_list.go#L251
Yup, found that one! Still double checked if it was ok 😂

- Related https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/8076
Nice, so yes, looks like we can start looking into using that

Not a blocker, but starting to wonder if we need to move this somewhere central (I was planning to move the image types from `types` to `types/image`, so perhaps that's a good opportunity).

Also considering that sorting may at some point be something we want on the client side as well

Ugh, calling `GetImage` for every image, constructing a big `image.Image` and getting just one of its properties looks very wasteful.
With pointer being returned, this will probably cause many memory allocations to happen on each list operation.
Could we have a smaller `GetImage` that would only unmarshal one property from the config?
Agreed, `GetImage` does a lot of things and loads a bunch of things we don't necessarily need here or in other places of the code. I would like to make listing work as intended before optimizing
[See related comment](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/46034/files#r1269246645) :)
